One NEW independently AI-redrawn game animation sprite, frame NE/5. EDIT TARGET first reference: preserve exact direction, head and body size, camera distance, root center and costume. FAN COUNT ONLY. Preserve the entire original pose, anatomy, sleeves, hand grip, legs, shoe direction, camera, head/body size and registration unchanged. Redraw the fan as EXACTLY FIVE rectangles with five visible distinct top edges: count five total, no narrow sixth sliver, no doubled border looking like an extra card. Preserve fan position/spread and original red-gold material. Do not alter original correct right shoulder→right hand→fan or left shoulder→left hand→bell. All other character details and transparent alpha unchanged.
Full original red gold fire boy: brown ponytail ruby crown, tied rear coat, black trousers, red gold shoes. LEFT HAND one brass bell; RIGHT HAND fan of FIVE red talismans. Same original soft painted Q-dao style. Portrait and style references are identity/material only, never their camera or screen handedness. Square native1024+ true alpha, full body margins; no autozoom, no mirror, no copied parts or interpolation. No floor, shadow, effects, text or particles.
